description: October 1 birthday meaning: Libra decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 1 birthday falls in Libra, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: The October 1 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: October begins at about eight degrees of Libra, still within the first decan where Venus rules both sign and sub-division. That gives the 1st a graceful, sociable surface. Underneath sits the birthday number 1, numerology's pioneer. The combination is often read as quiet determination in good clothes: someone who knows exactly what they want and asks for it very politely.

Astronomically, October 1 puts the Sun near 8° Libra in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. Libra's first decan, from about September 23 to October 2, holds Venus as both sign ruler and sub-ruler. This is traditionally the most graceful and relationship-minded part of the sign. Fairness, harmony and aesthetic sense are emphasised, along with a gift for making guests feel welcome. Those born here often weigh every side of a decision, which makes them good mediators and occasionally slow choosers. The doubled Venus influence can also lead to avoiding conflict at the cost of honesty. Growth often arrives with the discovery that a fair outcome sometimes requires an uncomfortable conversation first.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for October 1
paragraphs: Born on the 1st, your birthday number is a plain 1, with no compound behind it. In Pythagorean numerology the day of birth is a secondary number, a talent or flavour that sits alongside the Life Path rather than replacing it. A first-of-the-month birthday is traditionally read as the purest form of initiative: a self-starting streak, a preference for making decisions personally and a comfort with going first. Because there is nothing to reduce, the energy is often described as direct and uncomplicated. The usual counsel is to pair that independence with listening, so leadership does not become lonely.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an October 1 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous October 1 birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 1 is the 274th day of the year (275th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Scorpio, is usually complete within 23 days, by October 24.

By October 1 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an October 1 birthday are Jimmy Carter (1924), Theresa May (1956) and Julie Andrews (1935).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 1?
faq.answer: October 1 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Libra, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 1?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 1 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 1st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 1?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 1, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 1?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on October 1 include Jimmy Carter (1924), Theresa May (1956) and Julie Andrews (1935). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
